name: reviewloop
description: Drive a PR to all-clear across every reviewer — Greptile, CodeRabbit, Copilot, other bots, and humans. Bots get re-triggered and re-checked in a loop; humans get one pass then hand back.

interface.shortDescription: Loop a PR to all-clear across every reviewer — bot and human
interface.longDescription: Use Reviewloop to drive a pull request to a fully-clear state across every reviewer. It detects each reviewer structurally (bot vs human), re-triggers bot reviews (Greptile, CodeRabbit, Copilot) after each fix, resolves threads, and loops until nothing actionable remains. Humans get one pass — addressed and re-requested — then it hands back.
